flow: composer model panel -> 'Context length' picker (state key selectContextLength) feeding ChatRequestOptions.context_length on the next ChatService.Chat send (same stream as normal chat; no separate endpoint)

steps.note: session-locked vault replay (data/sessions/www.kimi.ai/) on www.kimi.ai (the 'next' Vue SPA)

if no picker row renders, click button.model-item hasText 'K3 Chat & Agent' first, then reopen the panel — the context-length row ONLY exists for models carrying contextLengthOptions (K3 family; the Instant speed model has none — measured)
click button[data-testid='model-context-length-item'] (class effort-item, role menuitem, data-close-on-select=false, label 'Context length' + current value)

options render as button[data-testid='model-context-length-option'] (class effort-option, role menuitemradio) carrying data-context-length=<kimi.common.v1.ContextLength enum> + aria-checked for the active one; MEASURED option set on K3 Chat & Agent: name 'Standard' (L=5, default, selectable) and 'Extra Long' (XL=6, footnote 'Allegro/Max plan only · Up to 1M tokens; consumes more credits')

click the row for the target enum (args.length, default: 6 Extra Long / 5 Standard). On a non-Max account 'Extra Long' opens the measured plan-gate modal div[data-testid='confirm-dialog'] under div.modal-mask ('Extra Long / Available to subscribers on the Max plan or higher / Cancel / Upgrade') — the runner reports that honest blocker instead of a fabricated ok; no plan-gate and the row read-back reflects the target = applied (ok:true)

reads back the picker row (button[data-testid='model-context-length-item'] innerText) to confirm the applied length; the choice feeds selectContextLength -> ChatRequestOptions.context_length on the next Chat send

output.current: string (active length on the picker row)
output.gate: string|null (measured plan-gate text when the target is plan-gated)

rpc: Long context is a per-request OPTION on the existing chat RPC — no dedicated endpoint. ChatService.Chat (kimi.gateway.chat.v1) ChatRequest.options.context_length (kimi.common.v1.ContextLength enum) rides POST https://notilo.kimi.com/apiv2/kimi.gateway.chat.v1/ChatService/Chat alongside thinking (K3 bool) and reasoning_effort; the composer picker's selectContextLength state feeds the same field. ContextLength enum decoded from slides_pb-AwrR1BR7.js (2026-09-23): UNSPECIFIED=0, XXS=1, XS=2, S=3, M=4, L=5, XL=6, XXL=7, XXXL=8, XXXXL=9 — the picker rows carry data-context-length=5 (Standard) and 6 (Extra Long).
known: Verified mechanism live 2026-09-23 (runner proof on the vault account): picker rows + enum codes 5/6 measured on K3 Chat & Agent; applying Standard (L=5) returns ok:true with real read-back; Extra Long (XL=6, the long-context option) is PLAN-GATED on this free account (measured gate text above) and cannot be applied without a Max plan session — the runner returns the honest blocker, never a fabricated ok.
stealth: real session (localStorage access_token Bearer), trusted inputs through the site's own model-panel JS; no synthetic RPC; long-context turns stream longer, keep the read timeout generous
